comparison.objective: Select required parts from a moving conveyor and assemble the pictured model while rejecting distractors.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual discrimination, time-dependent picking, buffering, stacking, and sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: Four correct parts form the target model, all distractors exit, the belt is never jammed, and assembly is stable.
comparison.reason: Tests perception-driven sorting and assembly under conveyor timing. No comparable continuous-support bearing transfer or free-ball preservation is present.
